title: Evidence-bound project transfer
root_cause: Project transfer accepts caller-trusted booleans as primary sanitization, approval, ownership, and test authority.
source_requirement: Make exact receipts primary authority and keep booleans only as derived projections.
implementation_steps: Define required receipt types and freshness.
Resolve sanitization, human approval, destination ownership, and test evidence.
Derive compatibility booleans from accepted receipts.
Fail closed on missing, stale, foreign, or mismatched evidence.
affected_tests: Project stream, trusted evidence, workspace transfer tests.
evidence_required: Positive and each negative authority-case receipt.
rollback: Disable transfer effects and retain prior booleans only as non-authoritative display data.
acceptance_criteria: No caller boolean independently authorizes transfer.
Every transfer binds all four current receipt classes.
